_comment: Hand-maintained model supplement for the CodeBuddy gateway.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
The gateway resolves its model list from the CodeBuddy CLI's cached
catalog (~/.codebuddy/local_storage). That catalog only moves when the
CLI itself is updated, so a model the upstream service already accepts
can stay invisible here for weeks. Entries below fill that gap.
HOW TO ADD A MODEL
1. Confirm the upstream actually accepts the slug before adding it:
curl -s localhost:8787/v1/chat/completions \
-H 'content-type: application/json' \
-d '{"model":"<slug>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":5}'
HTTP 200  -> good, add it below.
HTTP 400 with 'model [<slug>] service info not found' -> wrong slug,
do not add it.
2. Append one object to the "models" array below.
3. Save. The next request picks it up - no restart, no TTL wait, because
the gateway invalidates its cache when this file's mtime changes.
FIELDS
id                    upstream wire slug. Must match EXACTLY.
name                  display name.
supports_vision       true when the model accepts image input.
max_output_tokens     output cap. Use 48000 unless you know better.
reasoning             omit entirely for non-reasoning models.
{"effort": "max"} marks it as a reasoning model.
description           optional free text shown in listings.
NOTES
- Entries whose id already exists in the live catalog are ignored, so a
model promoted into the CLI later needs no cleanup here.
- 'reasoning.effort' seeds the default; the Codex effort picker menu is
still defined by _CODEX_REASONING_LEVELS in codebuddy_gateway/common.py.
